fields.name: ArgentSeaSiloBuilderExtensions grain-storage registration
fields.contract: ArgentSeaSiloBuilderExtensions exposes two grain-storage registration families. Each family accepts a provider name and has: (1) an ISiloBuilder extension that returns the same builder after configuring its services; (2) an ISiloBuilder extension that also accepts the corresponding persistence-options action; and (3) an IServiceCollection extension that accepts an OptionsBuilder action. The database family registers the database storage factory; the Shard family registers the Shard storage factory. In each family, supplied options are applied to options registered under the provider name before the storage registration is added.
